teacher_moves: Choose upward as positive and keep that choice attached to every vertical quantity.
Track the vertical velocity on one clock while gravity keeps acting downward.
Explain what the vertical-motion equation says before substituting.
learner_surface.worked_example: A projectile has vertical velocity 12 m/s upward after 1 s. With g = 10 m/s^2 downward, reconstruct the launch vertical component and check the sign physically.
learner_surface.faded_task: At 2 s the vertical component is 6 m/s upward and the vertical acceleration is -9 m/s^2. Set up the relation; complete only the final rearrangement yourself.
learner_surface.independent_task: A projectile has vertical velocity 3 m/s upward after 3 s with vertical acceleration -9 m/s^2. Find the launch vertical component, state why the model applies, and check the result.
